ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator profile (student-to-faculty ratio, campus setting)

stats.notes: CDS C1 residency table (fall 2024 entering class): the column under INTERNATIONAL gives 1,852 applied / 1,806 admitted / 197 enrolled (enrolled matches the B1 first-time nonresident count of 197). SAT percentiles are based on only 60 enrolled students. No early decision or early action; no waitlist. Applicant counts by residency sum to the total. Check marks for C7 (factors) are not readable in the PDF text, so factors are omitted.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (fall 2026) check boxes are not readable in the PDF text; policy taken from the international admissions page instead.

cost.notes: USD international cost page (30 credits per year; the page does not name the academic year): tuition and fees $13,616, living expenses $9,498, other (books, insurance, discipline fees) $2,400. The page leaves the total blank; $25,514 is the sum of those three lines. The page also mentions an annual tuition fee of $13,299, which does not match its own table. The CDS (2024-25) G1 tuition figures ($7,773 / $11,283) look out of date and are not used.
